title: Inter can't pick a keeper at kickoff against Shakhtar
caption: Inter can't walk into a Champions League night still picking its keeper. La Gazzetta dello Sport says Chivu will choose between Ivan Provedel and Josep Martínez only shortly before kickoff — and per inter.it Inter are 29th of 36 in Europe with no points.
